name: Lara Carey
life: “I still remember seeing my first grown-up skirt reflected in three panels.” On Friday, near Juniper Street, Lara knows which of the west-side porches has a seat in the shade.
voice: I want it for the mornings when I can't imagine another version of myself getting dressed.
appearance: Lara has closely cropped salt-and-pepper hair, a round face with a pronounced chin, and a favorite piece of clothing, a red windbreaker. It usually goes with a stitched row of blue crosses along an old repair. When somebody else has the floor, Lara holds eye contact until the other person has finished.
personality: Lara takes a rejection personally for a day and analytically on the second morning. Lara can be generous with a rival once the first night's sleep has intervened.
agenda: To see a next chapter in the familiar mirror.
family: Wynn Kapoor is Lara’s cousin’s child. Lara can always ask for five minutes alone. Wynn asks before bringing somebody along. It keeps a conversation between two people from unexpectedly turning into a family committee. Asked about *Nine unpaid hours*, Wynn says, “I missed child support because the transfer didn't come.”
connections: Gregory Lang. A would-be mirror buyer and its owner each have a personal history the other cannot put a price on. Also in the story is Laurence Williams (brother-in-law).
